name: Jayden Monson
positioning: Experience designer and operations leader: I turn stories into spaces people move through.
shift: I'm moving from franchise operations toward exhibit and experience design.
workIntro: I design exhibits and experiences across concept, storytelling, 3D modeling, media, and install. The work here is from Thanksgiving Point and from my own studies.
bio: I shape physical and intangible experiences: spaces, stories, service, and emotion. I bring creative direction to storytelling, guest flow, and blended experiences that mix AV, interactives, and fabricated environments.
I turn observation and research into better guest experiences. I back that with operations: journeys, coaching, and the routines that keep a visit consistent.
I lead operations at Painter1 Franchise, and I'm moving toward exhibit and experience design.

focus.title: Creative direction
focus.text: I set the vision, the drawings, and the story a space should tell before anyone builds it.

focus.title: Guest flow
focus.text: I shape how people move through light, sound, screens, scenery, and immersive walkthroughs.

focus.title: Operations
focus.text: I use research, coaching, and routines to keep a visit consistent for the next guest.

roles.title: Operations Lead
highlights: I map owner and customer journeys across 52 locations, and I launched the customer service division, bringing response times down 72%.
I lead owner and customer experience research, and I used it to design an upgraded customer-facing tech platform now adopted by 34% of customers.
I decide the KPIs that guide the system, run deep dives on location P&Ls, and I created the Owners’ Guide so best practices are repeatable.

roles.title: Exhibit Design Intern
highlights: I created the Jurassic Jungle shoe-room story video: I observed guests, storyboarded, gathered footage, and built it in After Effects, then installed it and fixed volume and loop timing on day 2.

I concepted a locker prop, an Apatosaurus skull specimen case from a stock clear hinged enclosure, and I modeled exhibit spaces in SketchUp, including the curved walkway and the kids’ area under the ramp.
I helped measure the Stegosaurus exhibit upgrade, joined the install team, and developed Buglands, a retheme of the Costa Rica Climber, with a concept deck and touchpoint models.

roles.title: Game Show Producer
highlights: I designed, directed, and ran an original themed game show for 300+ attendees, including the game loops, scripts, props, and visuals.

roles.title: Lab Director, Homelessness Lab
highlights: I led a human-centered design team to build a 3-month pilot, and I secured a nonprofit host and a 9-expert advisory board.
I introduced Scrum, which raised lab deliverables 175%, and I produced a 130+ page research paper that I was invited to present at UCUR 2025.

roles.title: Customer and Employee Experience Manager
highlights: I grew the staff 33% through hiring campaigns and lifted contracted events 40% with two marketing campaigns.

education.title: B.S. Experience Design and Management

education.detail: Minor in Global and Community Impact
highlights: I finished with a 3.99 GPA on a full-tuition Brigham Young Scholarship. Coursework included Experiential Design, Experiential Marketing, and Needfinding.
